sources.name: Ayuntamiento de Torrevieja urban bus stop inventory

transformations.description: Reuses canonical directional StopNodes from torrevieja-v1. OSM platform and stop_position components remain construction evidence rather than separate runtime graph vertices.

Unions routes by routeId and StopNodes by stable stopNodeId from torrevieja-legacy-east-v1, torrevieja-legacy-south-v1 and torrevieja-legacy-north-v1. Route objects are preserved unchanged apart from their containing scenario asset. No name-based StopNode merge and no reverse-edge inference is performed.
Carries forward the validated complete mappings for Lines A, A2 and C from torrevieja-legacy-east-v1.
Carries forward the validated complete mappings for Lines D-F and E from torrevieja-legacy-south-v1.
Carries forward the validated complete mappings for Lines B, G and H from torrevieja-legacy-north-v1.

Assigns stable physical tv-place identifiers from the conservative torrevieja-stop-node-to-stop-place-v1 registry. Exact-name, close, complementary-direction pairs may share a StopPlace; every other mapped StopNode remains a singleton. Route and pattern assets are unchanged.

warnings: This scenario is the exact route-and-StopNode union of the validated East, South and North development scenarios.
The merged scenario contains all eight captured legacy public route identities: A, A2, B, C, D-F, E, G and H.
All sixteen direction patterns remain independent; no return pattern was manufactured by reversing another pattern.
Line A contains both complete captured direction patterns: 22 outward and 26 return stop occurrences.
Line A2 contains both complete captured direction patterns: 14 outward and 18 return stop occurrences.
Line A2 intentionally reuses the established Route A StopNodes for Hotel Fontana, La Mata, Molino Blanco, Parquemar, San Policarpo and Eras de la Sal where the physical directional stop is shared.
Line A2's outbound Calle Helena occurrence uses the passenger platform StopNode tv-stop-0207; the nearby roadway stop-position is retained only as source evidence in the canonical universe.

Line A2's return Pinocchio occurrence uses passenger platform StopNode tv-stop-0200; its nearby roadway stop-position remains a separate source component because the original 10 metre projection threshold did not pair them.
Line C's return pattern represents the documented Hospital Quirón-serving variant; public information states that the hospital stop is not served on every circuit.
Line C's Cruz Roja occurrence maps to an unnamed canonical platform, and M. Fco. Casanovas maps to the canonical Patricio Zammit 67 node based on municipal address and route continuity.
The Ayuntamiento inventory was used as verification evidence only; no source photographs are distributed.
Review ODbL obligations before publicly distributing a derived database.
Line D-F contains both captured direction patterns: 17 outward and 18 return stop occurrences.
The D-F source repeats displayed sequence numbers in the return direction; clean order follows captured occurrence order.
A longer address-style D-F listing contains additional Avenida de las Olas detail; this scenario follows the independently captured two-direction lists and does not silently add another occurrence.
Line E contains both captured direction patterns: 23 outward and 9 return stop occurrences.
Line E's M. Fco. Casanovas occurrence maps provisionally to unnamed OSM platform tv-stop-0027, distinct from the following Patricio Zammit node.
Line E's Los Balcones / Super Valú occurrence maps to unnamed OSM platform tv-stop-0014 using address and geographic continuity.
Line E's Calle Amazonas and Ángel García Rogel labels use directional OSM points whose mapped names are street-number or cross-street variants.
Hotel Doña Monse uses different directional StopNodes: tv-stop-0115 outbound and tv-stop-0170 return.
Line B is reused byte-for-byte at route-object level from the reviewed torrevieja-legacy-abc-v1 routes asset.
Line B contains 19 outward and 16 return stop occurrences; its source numbering anomaly is not used as graph order.
Line G contains both captured direction patterns: 21 outward and 13 return stop occurrences.
Line G uses separate opposite-direction OSM platform candidates for Parque de las Naciones, Torretas, Policía Local, Jardín del Mar and Centro de Salud San Luis where the source data supports them.
Line G's Avenida Robleda and El Salado occurrences map provisionally to the two unnamed nearby OSM platforms tv-stop-0038 and tv-stop-0037 respectively.
Line G's CV-905 / Mercadona San Luis occurrence maps provisionally to unnamed OSM platform tv-stop-0039.
Line G's return Gasolinera Shell / San Remo occurrence maps to unnamed OSM platform tv-stop-0036, located opposite the named outbound San Remo stop.

The municipal inventory distinguishes separate directional Doña Inés records, but the OSM universe currently supplies only one canonical candidate; tv-stop-0127 is therefore shared by the two patterns.
Line H contains both complete captured patterns: 6 outward and 4 return stop occurrences and operates only on Fridays.
Line H's Hotel Juan Carlos / Calle Apolo return occurrence maps provisionally to tv-stop-0129, the nearby opposite-direction BP/Inmaculada canonical node.
Line H's DOMTI occurrence shares tv-stop-0069 with La Gaviota because the municipal address is Avenida Diego Ramírez Pastor 125.

StopPlace grouping does not create passenger route edges, reverse edges, or vehicle-cycle handoff edges. In particular, tv-stop-0207 and tv-stop-0209 share a physical StopPlace while remaining distinct graph vertices.
